answer: Synchronized validation sessions: at one announced minute each month, every identity's operator must solve a short batch of picture puzzles within two minutes, and randomly chosen peers check the answers against the agreed solutions. Missing or failing the window removes earning rights until the next session. Because all sessions run at once, one person can keep only one identity alive; ten identities need ten people at the same minute. A nebula of bot-run accounts gains nothing, though calling it airtight would be a fable: hired crowd workers remain a ridge attackers can still climb.
